description: Non-material amendments to planning permission 2016/2841 dated 06/02/2018 comprising the following changes to the description of development: clarify construction is phased; update use classes to reflect updates to the Use Class Order (2020); and remove reference to the number of homes and floorspace area and instead include a condition setting out consented quantums of development.
